discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 to 251_b081/275_b129/299_b153 (keys reused). 30 standard searches, snippets only. New 2023 BoxLunch single-pin releases: Disney 100 Character Pins (Aug), New Disney 100 Pins (Sep), Disney100 Sketch Lenticular (Loungefly, Nov), Peppermint Mocha (Loungefly, Oct), Disney100 Songs (Dec 2023/Jan 2024), Steamboat Willie Disney 100 (Uncas, Mar), Elemental portraits (May), Haunted Mansion 2023 (Aug, id-block hold), Wish Valentino & Star. No mystery holds released; Glitter Dresses maker re-confirmed; Tangled Valentine set supported by DPB snippet.
